name: filter-bar
title: FilterBar
description: Box of filter rows for lists (Catalogue, Workflows, Traces): a search field with an icon, titled rows of chips or segmented controls, a trailing group and a link-style Reset (n).

a11y.pattern: <section aria-label> with rows; titled rows are role="group" named by their title; native search input inside its label
keyboard: Moves through the search field, the filter controls and Reset in reading order
aria: The search label is visually hidden and repeated as the placeholder, so the field has a visible hint and a name
Each titled row is a group named by its title ("Protocol", "Labels")
Reset writes the number of active filters and is disabled when there is none
Announce the new result count in a role="status" region elsewhere
a11y.notes: Use Chip (toggle, protocol) and Segmented for the controls inside the rows.
